entries.32c7675e1650fc9a: An independent Internet service provider that offers the Internet connection service "ASAHI Net" to individuals and corporations, and also provides the educational support service "manaba".
entries.a41060cd2745289a: Services provided in addition to internet connection services. There are value-added connection services such as email and security, and the cloud-based educational support service "manaba", developed in-house. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,315 million, of which "manaba" accounted for ¥560 million and other services such as email and security accounted for ¥754 million.
entries.b4e6becf86bc5765: A service that provides internet connection environments to customers. It combines a backbone line operated with the company's own technology and access lines of partner telecommunications carriers to offer "AsahiNet Hikari" FTTH connections, mobile connections and other services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,202 million, of which ¥9,786 million was from the member-oriented ISP "ASAHI Net", and ¥2,415 million was from the VNE "v6 Connect", which wholesales IPv6 connectivity to telecommunications carriers.
entries.eb55ae03718e4dce: A business that provides internet connection services and internet-related services to individuals or corporations. Segment information is reported as a single segment, ISP business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,517 million.
